title: Bitget Lists Jio Pre-IPO Perpetual Futures
description: Bitget's JIOUSDT pre-IPO futures are live with a 20x trading limit as Jio Platforms prepares its October 21-23 share offering in India.

title: Blur to retire marketplace site and end new Blend loans on Nov. 12
description: Blur will deprecate the blur.io frontend on Nov. 12 while its Ethereum marketplace contracts stay live onchain, and its Blend lending service will stop matching new loans the same day.

title: New iPhone spyware scans crypto wallets, iVerify finds
description: iVerify disclosed a DarkSword variant called P7 that scans infected iPhones for wallet apps, pulls imToken data and Keychain passwords, and checks for orders every 15 seconds.

title: LDK patches reconnect flaw that let peers steal forwarded bitcoin
description: LDK's Oct. 1 security releases v0.2.7 and v0.1.13 fix a channel-reconnect lie that could cost forwarding nodes a payment, plus an LSPS2 amount check and a stale-state loss.

title: Binance to shut mining pool and cloud services on Nov. 10
description: Binance will discontinue Binance Pool, Pool Savings, Cloud Mining and Transaction Accelerator at 07:00 UTC on Nov. 10, giving miners four weeks to move hashrate elsewhere.
